description: This file defines constants, types, and functions related to Huggingface models, including model catalog, model inference, and API interaction for model discovery.

methods.name: isHuggingfacePolicyLocked
methods.description: Checks if a model reference string ends with a policy suffix indicating a locked policy.

methods.name: buildHuggingfaceModelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs a ModelDefinitionConfig object from a Huggingface model entry.

methods.name: isReasoningModelHeuristic
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a model ID suggests reasoning capabilities.

methods.name: inferredMetaFromModelId
methods.description: Infers model name and reasoning flag from model ID.

methods.name: displayNameFromApiEntry
methods.description: Generates display name for a model based on API entry data.

methods.name: discoverHuggingfaceModels
methods.description: Fetches and constructs a list of model definitions from Huggingface API or returns default catalog in test or error conditions.
